messages.subject: Error: "no lines available in input"
parts:
Hello,

I’m encountering an issue while trying to run RSWAT:

[SPS-ERROR] 2023-04-30 20:51:34 task 19 failed - "no lines available in input"

The simulation starts without any problems, but near the end, this error occurs, causing the run to stop prematurely.

Any advice on how to resolve this issue would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you!
